contextInstructions: When accessing Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides, or Calendar, use the google-drive MCP server tools.
When accessing Confluence pages or spaces, use the atlassian-confluence MCP server tools.
When accessing Bitbucket PRs, repos, or pipelines, use the bitbucket MCP server tools.
When sending Slack messages, use the Slack MCP server tools.
When accessing Gmail, use the Gmail MCP server tools.
When accessing Google Calendar events, use the Google Calendar MCP server tools.
For PR reviews, auto-detect the repo type from package.json and apply appropriate guidelines from the devkit guidelines/ directory.
When generating diagrams, prefer Mermaid for technical diagrams and Excalidraw for freeform/architectural diagrams.
